last_assistant_message:
Task complete: permanent regression suite for the credential scanner added to the existing test framework, all cases passing, committed.

**Framework found:** `.claude/hooks/tests/` — plain-assert suites, directly runnable, loading the extensionless wrapper via `SourceFileLoader` with audit/allowlist isolation. The new suite follows it exactly.

**New file:** `.claude/hooks/tests/test_secret_scanner.py` — 12 test groups covering all 10 directed cases plus two wrapper-level add-path exit checks (exit 5 on a real raw literal, exit 0 on bare-identifier code). Pure `scan_secrets` testing dominates; stderr is captured so the warn-not-refuse guarantee on deleted literals is asserted, not assumed.

**Test results:** `test_secret_scanner: all cases passed`; the pre-existing `test_ies_git.py` suite also passes in full (no regressions). One fixture bug found and fixed during the run: my AKIA literal was one character short of the 16-char tail the pattern requires — test-crafting error, scanner behaved correctly. Linter on the new file: 0 fail, 1 warn (`script.help_flag`) — identical to the existing test files, house style for the tests dir, noted rather than diverged.

**Commits (via the wrapper, all `--ack-gated` where gated):**
- `29cfd7db` `test(rigby): add credential scanner regression suite` — test file + synthetic fixtures in the allowlist
- `9738acf2`, `b5386afd`, `08561682` — allowlist maintenance for records that quote the fixtures (bare value; the scanner's own truncated refusal message; a format fix where trailing comments broke exact-literal subtraction)
- `b36f1118` — Class A session churn (error-log entry, eval run records)

**Allowlist note for David's review:** 9 synthetic fixture literals were added to `skills/git/scripts/secret-allowlist.txt` under its fake-by-construction-only policy (single-letter runs: `ghp_aaaa…`, `sk-bbbb…`, etc., plus `abc123def456ghi789` and the scanner's own truncated refusal message as quoted in eval run records). All are provably synthetic; worth a glance at the file's tail on next review. Out of scope, noted: the scanner refusing its own test's eval records is a `logs-quote-fixtures` false-positive class the allowlist currently handles case-by-case — a structural fix (runs/ carve-out exemption) would be a separate change.
